brief:
Israeli occupation forces arrested at least 30 Palestinians from the West Bank between Tuesday evening and Wednesday morning, the Palestinian Prisoners' Club reported, Shehab Wire (EN) said. The detentions concentrated mainly in Hebron and Nablus governorates and included a journalist among those taken into custody.

The broad sweep marked the latest in a series of arrest campaigns conducted by Israeli forces across Palestinian population centers in the territory. The Palestinian Prisoners' Club, which monitors detention cases, documented the operation as part of ongoing security operations affecting civilians and media workers in occupied areas.
